title: Page 8
content_zh:
「雪莹，我只求你能相信我，让我还能有弥补的机会……」他紧抱着她，哽声恳求，早已抛去身为王的自尊。
「我信……我信你……」他是王呀，却低下姿态反过来求她，听得她心都揪痛起来，竟比五脏六腑的刺痛还要让她无法忍受。
为了她，他可以豁出性命，陪她同甘共苦、同生共死，这坚定无悔的付出，深深地震撼着她，她又怎能怀疑他的心意？
他爱她之深，已到了什么都可以妥协、牺牲的地步，他对她的痴情无人能敌，这样的他要是无法信任，又有谁能信任？
「太好了，雪莹……」兰霆感到万分激动，他终于等到她的原谅了。
原本远离他的心，终于又回到他身边了，从今往后，他绝不让任何误会再横亘在彼此之间，破坏两人的情感。他会紧紧抓住她的心，小心翼翼地护着，不再让她的心受到任何伤害了……
「族长，银针拿来了！」朵儿捧着一个精致木盒奔入房里。
宗薰拿到银针后，便要她守在房外，房里只留下她、兰霆、宗雪莹三人。
兰霆让怀中的人儿躺在床上，紧握着她的手，等待宗薰开始施咒。
宗薰先用银针在兰霆指上一刺，挤出一颗血珠，然后将血珠抹起，把兰霆的血印在宗雪莹的心口上，之后同样用宗雪莹的血抹在兰霆的心口，完成施咒之前的准备。
之后，宗薰双手合十指结咒印，闭起双眼，开始念着他们听不懂的咒文，一段时间后，兰霆感到头有些昏沈，昏眩感越来越强烈。
而刚才落下血印的心口，逐渐热了起来，一股热意像是从肌肤慢漫渗入，烫着他的心，奇怪的灼痛感教他难以喘气，意识也渐渐模糊，即将昏了过去。
他努力地想保持清醒，但心口的疼痛难耐还是压过他的意识，双眼慢慢合起，被黑暗所吞噬。
在他完全失去意识之前，他心中所想的只有一件事，那就是——
只要雪莹能够脱离险境，他无怨无悔，再痛他也愿意承受……
第9章(1)
当兰霆再度睁开双眼时，才发现自己是躺在客房当中，他的脑袋还有些昏沈，全身酸痛无力。
随行上山的贴身太监看到兰霆终于苏醒，欣慰地说：「王，您可终于醒了。」
「本王……昏睡了多久？」
「已经整整三日。」

这么久?!他费力地坐起身来，却感到五脏六腑有种莫名的刺痛感。
原来这就是雪莹这一阵子所承受的病痛折磨，他只帮她承担一半，就已感到很不好受，他真不敢想像之前她是怎么忍受这加倍的痛苦。
「王，您还是躺在床上多歇息吧，隐族族长吩咐过，您的身子会很不舒服，别太勉强做任何事。」太监看他脸色苍白，很担心王的身子状况。
但兰霆根本不管太监的劝阻，执意掀被下床，太监吓得赶紧阻止。「王，您别——」
「本王要去见雪莹，闪开，别碍着本王的路！」他瞪着一直阻止他下床的太监，语气虽然有些虚弱，威势还在。
太监无奈地叹了口气，只好赶紧跟着他出客房。
兰霆强忍着身子的不适，来到宗雪莹的房里，当他一进到房内，在床旁照顾的朵儿便起身向他行礼，脸上有着感激与欣喜。
他来到床边，看着躺在床上的宗雪莹，她脸上依旧缺乏血色，但已不像吐血时惨白得可怕，让他看了心惊。
「雪莹……」他轻抚着她的脸蛋，大大松了口气，幸好她已经暂时脱离险境，现在就只需要等百灵昙开花的日子到来，他相信，这一次她肯定能够熬到春暖花开的日子。
宗雪莹感受到脸颊上轻柔的抚摸，慢慢睁开双眼，看到脸色同样苍白的兰霆，她既欣慰、也心疼，知道自己身上的病痛之所以减轻不少，都是因为他不计后果地替她承担了。
她漾起淡而柔的微笑，情意深深地唤道：「王……」
「雪莹，我想听你唤我的名字。」
「霆……兰霆……」
他欣喜地俯下身，和她额抵着额，紧紧地抱着她，像是恨不得将她给揉入自己的骨血当中，再也不要分开。「在你的面前，我不是王，只是个爱你的男人，我喜欢听你唤我的名，以后就这么唤我吧。」
「好。」她伸出手，轻轻地回抱，笑容更是甜美，只要他喜欢，要她唤他什么都行，她都会心甘情愿地照做。
最危急的时刻都已经熬过去了，再也没什么事情好让他们担忧害怕，他期待着她痊愈的日子即将到来，他们会等到的，一定会……
兰霆醒来三日后，便到了除夕夜，在睽违十年之后，宗雪莹终于有机会和自己的亲人过年。
她坐在床上，看着朵儿和其他丫鬟在她房里忙碌，将饭菜端进她房里，等一会儿就会在她的房里用团圆饭了，但她有些心不在焉，一直往门边看，却始终看不到兰霆出现。
他说会陪她一起用团圆饭的，此刻天都已经暗下，却还是没见到他出现，不知道是怎么了？
恰巧这时候朵儿又端着菜进到房里，宗雪莹便问：「朵儿，你有见到王吗？」

朵儿勾起一抹神秘的笑。「小姐，再等一会儿，王马上就出现了。」
他们是不是有什么事瞒着她？虽然满肚子疑惑，宗雪莹还是只能待在房里等待着。
果然，没多久之后，兰霆就进到房里，来到床边，脸上也有着神秘的笑容。「雪莹，还记得咱们的约定吗？」
「什么约定？」他没头没尾的突然冒出这样一句话，她毫无头绪。
兰霆还是笑，并且将她的披风拿过来，亲自替她披上，紧接着将她抱起，想要带她出房去。
「霆，你到底想做什么？」宗雪莹惊讶地赶紧环抱住他的肩，不由得担心他的身子状况。「你的身子同样不好受，这样抱着我，你会更难受的。」
「我没你想的那样不济事。」兰霆没好气地瞪了她一眼。「只有一小段路，不碍事的。」
他的身子的确挺不舒服，但还没到抱不起她的地步，况且她很轻，轻得让他忍不住想皱眉，之后非得命人好好地帮她补一补，非得将她养胖点不可。
兰霆将宗雪莹抱出房，来到一旁的小花园内，宗雪莹放眼望过去，没想到竟看见一盏盏散发着黄色光晕的圆形灯笼摆放在小花园里，而且到处都挂满了灯笼，照亮幽暗的黑夜。
他小心翼翼地将她从怀中放下，让她靠在他的臂弯里站着，两人便被数不清的灯笼给围绕住。
看着眼前灿亮的灯景，宗雪莹鼻头一酸，眼眶湿红，忍不住感动地落下泪来。
「只要你喜欢，每年新年，本王就让人在宫里点起花灯，请来杂耍艺人，专为你而表演……」
原来他说的是这个约定，虽然只是非常寻常的圆形灯笼，不是美丽的花灯，但这一盏盏的灯里，都满载着他对她无尽的情意，在她眼里比任何花灯都还要美丽且珍贵。
「哭什么？」他抹着她颊上的泪痕，有些懊恼地轻皱起眉，他可一点都不想见到她哭泣。「难道你不开心？不喜欢见到这些灯笼？」
「我当然开心。」她赶紧漾起笑，努力忍住泪水，伸手圈住他的腰，将脸蛋埋在他温暖的胸膛，轻轻磨蹭撒娇。「但就是太开心了，才忍不住喜极而泣嘛……」
兰霆的眉这下子才舒缓开来，爱怜地回抱着她，低头在她耳边柔声低喃。「今年只有灯，没有杂耍艺人，等到明年，我再加倍补偿你，我向你保证。」
content_en:
"Xueying, I just ask you to trust me and give me a chance to make amends..." He hugged her tightly and begged in a choked voice, having already abandoned his pride as a king.
"I believe...I believe you..." He was a king, but he begged her in a low manner. Her heart ached when he heard it, and it was even more unbearable than the stinging pain in her internal organs.
For her, he would risk his life and accompany her through thick and thin, life and death. This unwavering and unrepentant sacrifice deeply shocked her. How could she doubt his intentions?
He loves her so deeply that he can compromise and sacrifice anything. His infatuation for her is unmatched. If he can't be trusted, who can be trusted?
"That's great, Xueying..." Lan Ting felt extremely excited. He finally waited for her forgiveness.
The heart that had been far away from him finally came back to him. From now on, he would never let any misunderstanding stand between them and ruin their relationship. He will hold her heart tightly, protect it carefully, and never let her heart be hurt again...
"Chief, here's the silver needle!" Duo'er ran into the room holding an exquisite wooden box.
After Zong Xun got the silver needle, he asked her to stay outside the room, leaving only her, Lan Ting, and Zong Xueying in the room.
Lan Ting let the person in his arms lie on the bed, holding her hand tightly, waiting for Zong Xun to start casting the spell.
Zong Xun first pricked Lan Ting's finger with a silver needle, squeezed out a drop of blood, then wiped the blood drop, and printed Lan Ting's blood on Zong Xueying's heart. Then he also used Zong Xueying's blood to wipe Lan Ting's heart to complete the preparations before casting the spell.
After that, Zong Xun clasped his hands together to form a curse seal, closed his eyes, and began to recite a mantra that they could not understand. After a while, Lan Ting felt a little dizzy, and the dizziness became more and more intense.
The heart where the blood mark had just fallen gradually began to heat up. A warmth seemed to seep slowly from his skin, scalding his heart. The strange burning sensation made it difficult for him to breathe, and his consciousness gradually became blurred, and he was about to pass out.
He tried hard to stay awake, but the unbearable pain in his heart still overwhelmed his consciousness. His eyes slowly closed and were swallowed by darkness.
Before he completely lost consciousness, there was only one thing on his mind, and that was——
As long as Xueying can escape from danger, he has no regrets and is willing to bear no matter how painful it is...
Chapter 9(1)
When Lan Ting opened his eyes again, he realized that he was lying in the guest room. His head was still a little dizzy and his whole body was sore and weak.
The personal eunuch who accompanied him up the mountain saw Lan Ting finally regaining consciousness and said happily: "King, you are finally awake."
"How long have I... been asleep?"
"It's been three full days."
So long?! He struggled to sit up, but felt an inexplicable tingling sensation in his internal organs.
It turned out that this was the pain and suffering that Xueying had been suffering for a while. He only helped her bear half of it, and she already felt very uncomfortable. He really couldn't imagine how she had endured this double pain before.
"King, you should lie in bed and rest more. The leader of the Yin tribe has told you that your body will be very uncomfortable. Don't force yourself to do anything." The eunuch saw his pale face and was worried about the king's health.
But Lan Ting ignored the eunuch's dissuasion and insisted on getting out of bed. The eunuch was so frightened that he quickly stopped him. "King, please don't—"
"I want to see Xueying, get out of my way!" He glared at the eunuch who had been preventing him from getting out of bed. Although his tone was a little weak, his power was still there.
The eunuch sighed helplessly and had to follow him out of the guest room quickly.
Lan Ting endured the discomfort and came to Zong Xueying's room. As soon as he entered the room, Duo'er, who was taking care of her beside the bed, stood up and saluted him, with gratitude and joy on her face.
He came to the bedside and looked at Zong Xueying lying on the bed. Her face still lacked blood, but it was no longer as horribly pale as when she vomited blood, which frightened him.
"Xueying..." He gently stroked her face,He breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, she was out of danger for the time being. Now she only had to wait for the day when the Bai Ling Tan bloomed. He believed that this time she would be able to survive until the spring came.
Zong Xueying felt the gentle touch on her cheek, and slowly opened her eyes. When she saw Lan Ting, whose face was also pale, she was both relieved and distressed. She knew that the reason why her pain was relieved a lot was because he shouldered it for her regardless of the consequences.
She smiled lightly and softly, and called with deep affection: "King..."
"Xueying, I want to hear you call my name."
"Ting... Lan Ting..."
He leaned down happily, pressed his forehead against hers, and held her tightly, as if he wished he could knead her into his own bones and blood and never separate her again. "In front of you, I am not a king, I am just a man who loves you. I like to hear you call my name. Please call me that in the future."
"Okay." She stretched out her hand and hugged him back gently, her smile even sweeter. As long as he liked it and asked her to call him whatever he wanted, she would do it willingly.
The most critical moment has passed, and there is nothing to worry or fear about anymore. He is looking forward to the day when she recovers soon. They will wait for it, and they will definitely...
Three days after Lan Ting woke up, it was New Year's Eve. After ten years of absence, Zong Xueying finally had the opportunity to celebrate the New Year with her relatives.
She sat on the bed and watched Duo'er and other maids busy in her room, bringing food into her room. They would have a reunion dinner in her room later, but she was a little absent-minded and kept looking towards the door, but she never saw Lan Ting appear.
He said he would have a reunion dinner with her. It was already dark now, but he still didn't appear. I don't know what happened?
It happened that Duo'er came into the room again carrying dishes, and Zong Xueying asked: "Duo'er, have you seen the king?"
Duoer gave a mysterious smile. "Miss, wait a little longer, the king will appear soon."
Are they hiding something from her? Although full of doubts, Zong Xueying could only stay in the room and wait.
Sure enough, not long after, Lan Ting entered the room and came to the bedside with a mysterious smile on his face. "Xueying, do you still remember our agreement?"
"What agreement?" He suddenly said this without any clue, and she had no clue.
Lan Ting still smiled, and took her cloak and put it on her personally, then picked her up and wanted to take her out of the room.
"Ting, what do you want to do?" Zong Xueying quickly hugged his shoulders in surprise, and couldn't help but worry about his physical condition. "Your body is also uncomfortable. Holding me like this will make you even more uncomfortable."
"I'm not as helpless as you think." Lan Ting glared at her angrily. "It's only a short distance, it's out of the way."
His body was indeed quite uncomfortable, but not to the point where he couldn't hold her. Besides, she was very light, so light that he couldn't help but frown. He would have to order someone to patch her up and make her fatter.
Lan Ting carried Zong Xueying out of the room and went to the small garden nearby. Zong Xueying looked over and unexpectedly saw round lanterns with a yellow halo placed in the small garden, and there were lanterns hanging everywhere, lighting up the dark night.
He carefully put her down from his arms and let her stand in his arms, and the two of them were surrounded by countless lanterns.
Looking at the bright lights in front of her, Zong Xueying's nose felt sour, her eyes were wet and red, and she couldn't help but shed tears in emotion.
"As long as you like it, every New Year, I will have people light lanterns in the palace and invite jugglers to perform just for you..."
It turned out that he was talking about this agreement. Although it was just a very ordinary round lantern, not a beautiful lantern, these lanterns were filled with his endless affection for her, and in her eyes they were more beautiful than any lantern.Beautiful and precious.
"Why are you crying?" He wiped the tears on her cheeks and frowned slightly in annoyance. He didn't want to see her cry at all. "Aren't you happy? Don't you like seeing these lanterns?"
"Of course I'm happy." She quickly smiled and tried to hold back her tears. She put her arms around his waist, buried her face in his warm chest, and gently rubbed her coquettishly. "But I was so happy that I couldn't help but cry with joy..."
Lan Ting's eyebrows relaxed now, he hugged her back lovingly, lowered his head and whispered softly in her ear. "This year there are only lights and no jugglers. Next year, I will make it up to you twice as much, I promise you."
